description: With release_id: the release's "Around the release" checklist (pitch, pre-save, Canvas, lyrics, release day and the weeks after), each with when it is due, why, where it is done and whether it is done. Without: the artist's "Set up once" list (Instagram ready to post, photos and clips for the posts, claiming the store profiles, the bio link).

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

release_id.description: The release (list_releases). Leave out for "Set up once".

name: list_release_todos
title: A release's checklist
